question: Should OpenClaw accept native compaction results that are produced immediately after safety-timeout cancellation during this bounded commit window?
rationale: This changes the session-state rule from fail-closed on any aborted compaction signal to accepting one exact timeout reason while the safety wrapper still owns it, which is a maintainer runtime policy decision rather than a purely mechanical patch defect.

options.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
options.body: Allow the exact-timeout WeakSet window, then require current-head CI and normal merge checks before landing.

options.title: Keep native timeout fail-closed
options.body: Preserve the inner chunk partial-summary and timeout-copy fixes, but remove the AgentSession acceptance path so timeout-aborted native compaction never commits after cancellation.

options.title: Pause for fuller runtime proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a live slow-provider or full gateway compaction transcript proves the bounded commit path under realistic runtime load.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
recommendation.body: Allow the exact-timeout WeakSet window, then require current-head CI and normal merge checks before landing.
